observations: Three photos show a pair of car headlamps stacked on a wooden block in a workshop-like setting.
The headlamps have a clear lens with a circular projector-style main beam and a separate smaller bulb or reflector on the side.
The housing is white plastic with mounting tabs and clips visible.
The lower headlamp has a red section on the outer edge, likely for turn signal or side marker.
No visible brand or model markings on the headlamps themselves in any photo.
The headlamps appear to be used, with some minor scratches and dust on the lens.
The background includes metal tools, pipes, and a person’s leg, suggesting a repair or scrap yard environment.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers in any photo. The design is consistent with some Toyota models, but not confirmable.
‘Grade One tokumbo’ is a subjective quality claim common in Nigerian used parts market; cannot be verified from photos alone.
Photos show the headlamps present and in view, suggesting they are in stock.

risks.risk: Not genuine Toyota Highlander headlamps or incorrect model year
risks.proof: A clear photo of the back of the headlamps showing part numbers or OEM markings, or a photo of the headlamps installed on a 2011/2012 Toyota Highlander.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used headlamps, not as specific model parts

risks.risk: Headlamps are damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lens, broken bulb holders, wiring issues)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the internal components, bulb sockets, and wiring harnesses, and a video showing them lit up.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with unknown functionality

risks.risk: Headlamps are mismatched (e.g., left and right not a true pair, or different models mixed)
risks.proof: Side-by-side comparison photo showing both headlamps from the same angle, including mounting points and internal structure.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit or with reduced value for mismatch

proof_requests: Clear photo of the back of the headlamps showing any part numbers or OEM markings.
Close-up of the internal bulb sockets and wiring harnesses.
Photo showing both headlamps side by side from the front and side angles for comparison.
Video or photo of the headlamps turned on to verify functionality.
response.reason: The headlamps cannot be confirmed as Toyota Highlander 2011/2012 model from the current photos. Without proof of model, functionality, and condition, a worst-case price cannot be reliably assigned. The seller’s claims are unverified or unverifiable, and hidden risks affect value.
